world_prompt: Generate the complete original production asset, map, mechanics, animation, audio, VFX, UI, AI, and Godot integration bundle for Zom Nom Defense. Preserve its grounded stylized-realistic suburban apocalypse identity, readable humor, tactical defense-building loop, multi-level pool-house combat, road and vehicle defense, stair-climbing zombies, pool interactions, escalating horde pressure, and strong top-down gameplay readability.

visual_language.identity: grounded stylized realism with handcrafted suburban details and readable survival-comedy
visual_language.camera: three-quarter tactical camera with clear silhouettes and uncluttered interaction zones
visual_language.material_rule: physically plausible weathering, restrained grime, no baked lighting, no logos, no generic cyberpunk
visual_language.content_rule: original assets only; no copied third-party game content

scenarios.description: Defend survivors across a two-story suburban home, garage, balcony, pool deck, yard, roof edges, and utility shed.
Protect and upgrade the survivor muscle car through a blocked highway, gas station, motel edge, culvert, drainage ditch, and wreck field.
